System architecture

Problem: online shoppers and walk-ins compete for the same physical units.
Duplicate clicks and missed deadlines can cause overselling or blocked stock.

JSON
SSE

SQL
commit

Lua request counting

Outbox dispatch
and state rechecks

Jobs

Load targets the same API

One reservation, one commit

1 Validate the request

Check identity, quantity and retry key

2 Protect physical stock

Lock allocation and leave two available

3 Save the whole change

Hold, units, response, event and outbox

4 Return confirmation

Receipt first, scheduled work follows

Observed local race

100 requests / 100 concurrency
1 unique hold, 99 stock conflicts
All three inventory checks passed

Walk-in rule: five available units allow three online holds. Fitting stock stays protected until purchase or confirmed physical return.

React + TypeScript provides the customer, staff and benchmark screens. Select a technology for its role.

Deep explanation + speaking script
Local Go implementation. Normal holds: 24h. Judging mode: 120s. Synthetic social inputs and local inbox delivery.06 / 07
